summary: Slice-3 Wallet feature verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 9/9 pass covering: (a) fresh driver zero-balance shape, (b) verify-delivery credits DriverEarning with matching job_id/kind='fare'/currency='INR' + retry stays at lifetime=fare (unique (job_id, kind) index + 409 on re-verify — no double-credit), (c) dashboard today.earnings.amount sourced from ledger (=₹156 post-delivery, not 0), (d) all four withdrawal validation branches: below_minimum (amount=50<100 → 400), insufficient_balance (999999 → 400), withdrawal_pending (2nd request while pending → 409), bank_missing (fresh un-KYC'd driver → 409). Success path: POST withdrawal returns status='pending', available_balance drops to 0 (locked=lifetime), currency=INR, GET /me/withdrawals returns newest-first. Frontend Playwright E2E on iPhone viewport (390x844): dashboard shows driver-wallet-entry tile which navigates to /driver/wallet; wallet-balance-card renders ₹156 at wallet-available-balance; wallet-withdraw-cta enabled when balance>0; range-picker today/week/month switches wallet-range-amount correctly (all show ₹156 for this run since delivery is today); wallet-ledger-list renders the fare row; tapping cta opens wallet-withdraw-sheet prefilled with 156; wallet-withdraw-submit posts, sheet closes, success toast 'Payout requested' shows, wallet-pending-strip appears with '₹156 · payout requested', and wallet-withdraw-cta becomes disabled with label 'Payout in progress'. No console errors seen on the wallet page.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/modules/driver/routes.py:634-643 — verify_delivery guards double-credit with a SELECT-then-INSERT inside the same session; the unique (job_id, kind) DB index is the real safety net if two concurrent requests race. In practice verify-delivery is also gated by the status transition check (`if j.status not in ('picked_up','arriving_dropoff')`) so a second call gets 409 before reaching the ledger block — verified by the idempotency test.
backend/modules/driver/routes.py:783 — bank_missing is checked BEFORE pending_withdrawal, below_minimum, and insufficient_balance. Ordering matches the review-request expectations.

backend/modules/driver/routes.py:751 — `locked = sum(w.amount for w in withdrawals if w.status in ('pending','paid'))` correctly excludes failed withdrawals so a rejected payout returns funds to available_balance. Confirmed by manual code inspection.
backend/modules/driver/routes.py:787 — request_withdrawal calls driver_earnings() to reuse balance math. Clean, no drift risk between GET and POST validation.

frontend/src/apps/driver/DriverApp.jsx:1156 — withdraw CTA disabled state correctly combines `available_balance <= 0 || !!pending`, so a driver with a pending payout even for a smaller amount still cannot open the sheet — verified in UI.
frontend/src/apps/driver/DriverApp.jsx:1245 — WithdrawSheet prefills `String(summary.available_balance)`; if available_balance is 0 the CTA is already disabled so the sheet never opens with 0 — safe.
